method.description: Recompute each line's exact one-line critical-wall neighborhood, retain the top six exact variants for each of 18 lines, then score every coordinated pair drawn from distinct-line frontiers.

interpretation: The top exact one-line wall moves do not combine pairwise to improve the verified 93 arrangement in this bounded frontier. This rules out only this explicit coordinated neighborhood.
next_search_direction: Pivot from coordinate-wall recombination to order-type/SAT search or a wider multi-line combinatorial move set; keep H1-12 concurrence-aware upper-bound work independent.
claim_boundary: Search failure does not establish a global upper bound, optimality of 93, or nonexistence of a 94/95 arrangement.
